user.current_work: Home lesson teacher (maths + chemistry for JSS/SSS)
user.health_constraints: Mother has diabetes, need to be reachable within 2 hours of Ibadan

user_snapshot: Microbiology grad, one year post-NYSC, stuck on ₦40k/month home tutoring in Ibadan with ₦200k savings, ₦25k monthly family load, and a diabetic mother keeping you tethered within 2 hours of home.
headline_insight: The 2-hour radius around Ibadan is not a cage — it puts you inside the Sagamu/Ota/Agbara pharma corridor, which is where your Microbiology degree actually pays. Most of your peers are applying to Lagos fintech roles they'll never get; you have a degree-matched market within reach that they don't.

routes.title: Pharma QA Analyst → Lab Tech JAPA Track
routes.one_liner: Land a QA role at a pharma plant in the Sagamu/Ota corridor, then stack IELTS + MLT credential for Canada/UK within 24 months.

fit_reasons.note: Microbiology Second Class Upper from a federal uni is exactly what Emzor, Fidson, May & Baker, GSK shortlist for QA.
Sagamu and Ota are both within 2 hours of Ibadan — fits your mother's diabetes constraint.

break_reasons.risk: Pharma QA shift work can mean 12-hour rotations; if mother's diabetes deteriorates, sudden absences risk probation.

routes.who_this_fits: A disciplined graduate who will grind a ₦150-180k QA role for 18 months to unlock the international MLT pathway.
routes.who_this_breaks: Someone hunting quick wins or unwilling to commute/relocate to the pharma corridor towns.

real_cost.what_you_give_up: Tutoring income for ~4 weeks during job search + relocation; evenings for study if you start IELTS/MLT prep in parallel.

real_pay.range_note: Entry ₦130-180k at local firms, ₦200k+ at GSK/Fidson. Corridor housing ₦150-400k/yr, not Lagos prices.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, if you land QA at Fidson or Emzor by mid-2026, you're earning ₦250-320k/mo as QA Analyst II, have ₦800k saved, IELTS booked, and a Canada MLT credentialing file open with CSMLS.
pro_tips: Apply directly via factory HR gates in Sagamu/Ota, not just Jobberman.
PSN membership signals seriousness to pharma HR even without Pharmacy degree.

monday_actions.step: Rewrite CV with QA keywords (GMP, GLP, SOP, HPLC exposure) and upload to MyJobMag, Jobberman, and LinkedIn with 'Open to Relocate: Ogun' tag.
Message 5 QA Analysts at Emzor, Fidson, May & Baker, GSK, and Swiss Pharma on LinkedIn asking one question about entry pathway.
Email HR@ of Evans Medical, Neimeth, and Drugfield (all corridor) with CV + short cover note.

routes.nigerian_notes: Corridor firms prefer walk-in CVs on Mondays/Tuesdays. Keep NYSC discharge cert + transcript scanned and ready — HR asks same day.

routes.title: International School Science Teacher (Ibadan)
routes.one_liner: Convert your tutoring grind into a ₦200-350k/mo salaried role at Chrisland, Corona, or Children's International in Ibadan.

fit_reasons.note: You already teach maths and chemistry — international schools hire exactly this for JSS/SSS science.
Ibadan-based school keeps you 0 km from your diabetic mother, zero relocation risk.

break_reasons.risk: Without a PGDE or TRCN certificate, top-tier schools cap offers at ₦150-200k; ceiling hits fast.

routes.who_this_fits: Someone who genuinely enjoys classroom teaching and wants stable income within 90 days with minimal risk.
routes.who_this_breaks: Anyone planning JAPA in under 24 months — teaching salaries make ₦15m proof-of-funds nearly impossible to save.

real_cost.what_you_give_up: Private tutoring flexibility; school hours 7:30am-4pm plus weekend coaching. TRCN exam fee ~₦25k.

real_pay.range_note: Ibadan tier below Lagos. Chrisland/Corona Ibadan ₦180-280k entry. British-curriculum schools pay more.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, if you join a tier-1 Ibadan school January 2026, you're earning ₦280-320k/mo as a senior science teacher, TRCN certified, possibly running a paid weekend coaching class adding ₦80k/mo.
pro_tips: Apply in April-May — schools hire before September term.
British-curriculum schools pay 30-40% above Nigerian-curriculum ones.

monday_actions.step: Email CVs to admin@ of Chrisland Ibadan, Corona Agodi, Children's International, The Vale College, and Whitesands.
Register for TRCN PQE exam on trcn.gov.ng — boosts offers by ₦50k minimum.
Record a 3-minute sample chemistry lesson on phone, upload unlisted YouTube, link in applications.

milestones: Offer for Jan or Sept term
Take on exam coaching for extra ₦40-80k

roadmap.focus: Senior role or JAPA teacher route
milestones: Head of science department OR Dubai/UK teacher visa research

routes.nigerian_notes: Ibadan international school market is smaller than Lagos but less saturated. The Vale College and Lead British Intl pay near-Lagos rates.

routes.title: Data Analyst Pivot (Excel → SQL → Remote)
routes.one_liner: Convert your Excel + research background into a data analyst role, local first (₦200-400k), then remote USD within 18-24 months.

fit_reasons.note: Excel + research from your Microbiology lab work is a genuine head-start over bootcamp beginners.
Fully remote-capable; you stay next to your mother with zero location lock-in.

break_reasons.risk: Junior analyst market in Nigeria is saturated in 2026; without portfolio + network you could spend 12 months earning nothing new.

routes.who_this_fits: Self-disciplined learner who can study 15 hours a week for 9 months while keeping the tutoring income.
routes.who_this_breaks: Anyone expecting bootcamp completion to produce a job — the credential is worthless without 3+ portfolio projects.

real_cost.what_you_give_up: Evenings and weekends for 9 months. ~₦100-150k for a focused course (DataCamp, Luxe Analytics) or free via Khan/Mode Analytics.

real_pay.range_note: Local entry ₦180-300k. Remote USD roles $1.5-3k/mo (~₦2.2-4.5m) after 18+ months of proven work.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, if you grind SQL + Python + Power BI with 5 portfolio projects, you're earning ₦350-550k/mo at a Lagos fintech remotely OR $1.5k/mo on Upwork, still based in Ibadan next to your mum.
pro_tips: Build portfolio projects using NBS or CBN data — local recruiters notice instantly.
SheCode Africa and DataFest Africa give faster referrals than any bootcamp.

monday_actions.step: Start free SQL course on Mode Analytics (mode.com/sql-tutorial) — commit to 1 hour/day.
Join SheCode Africa Slack, DataFest Africa Telegram, and Nigeria Data Scientists WhatsApp — post intro.
Follow 10 Nigerian data analysts on LinkedIn (search 'Data Analyst Lagos') and study their posted projects.

milestones: Complete 2 analysis projects on Kaggle/NBS data
Upwork profile with 3 reviews OR remote full-time Nigerian fintech

routes.nigerian_notes: Tutoring income ₦40k covers survival during the 9-month learning sprint. Don't quit it — it's your runway.

routes.title: Exam Coaching Centre (WAEC/JAMB Chemistry + Maths)
routes.one_liner: Scale your 1-on-1 tutoring into a 15-30 student weekend coaching class that 2-3x your income without leaving Ibadan.

fit_reasons.note: You already teach maths and chemistry at JSS/SSS level — the exact WAEC/JAMB coaching market.
₦200k covers space rental, printing, and flyers for a first cohort without touching family obligations.

break_reasons.risk: Enrolment is seasonal (peaks Jan-March and June-Oct); empty months mean ₦0 while costs continue.

routes.who_this_fits: A natural teacher with family network in Ibadan who can hustle parent referrals through church, mosque, and alumni circles.
routes.who_this_breaks: Anyone expecting steady salaried income — cashflow swings hard term-to-term.

real_cost.what_you_give_up: ₦150-200k upfront for rented hall (Bodija/Ring Road), printing past questions, flyers, DSTV subscription for streaming.

real_pay.range_note: 15 students × ₦15k/term = ₦225k/term. Scaled to 50 students with 2 subjects: ₦750k+/term. Seasonal, not monthly smooth.

routes.two_year_projection: In 2 years, if Bodija-based coaching takes off, you're running 40-60 students per WAEC/JAMB cycle, averaging ₦300-400k/mo blended, and hiring one assistant tutor for biology.
pro_tips: Partner with 2 secondary schools as 'approved holiday coach' — instant enrolment pipeline.
Charge per-term, not per-month — protects cashflow during exam breaks.

monday_actions.step: Visit 3 affordable hall spaces in Bodija, Ring Road, Challenge — negotiate ₦30-60k/month weekend-only rates.
Design one-page flyer + WhatsApp broadcast; send to every parent of current tutees + church/mosque youth groups.
Create WAEC/JAMB past-question workbook, print 30 copies at UI or Mokola printers (~₦8k).

routes.nigerian_notes: Ibadan parents pay ₦10-25k/term for group coaching. UI staff school parents and Bodija area pay premium (₦30k+). Avoid upfront big rent — start in a church hall or rented classroom.

routes_filtered_out.reason: ₦200k savings vs ₦18-30m required; impossible in your 24-month horizon without family backing you haven't mentioned.
Role requires constant inter-state travel; incompatible with 2-hour Ibadan radius for your mother's diabetes care.
Relocation away from mother + Lagos rent floor ₦600k/yr eats all savings; plus one year post-NYSC is outside most trainee windows.
Entry at 24+ with a degree is atypical and requires family introduction; 5-7 years of ₦0 income clashes with ₦25k monthly family obligation.
